categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文聚焦LLM的可靠性评测与容错，以及把领域结构知识注入模型的两条主线。

articles.title: Interpretable Singing Emotion Recognition Using Acoustic and Vocal Technique Features
articles.zh: 基于声学特征与演唱技巧特征的可解释歌声情感识别
articles.summary: 如果你在做音乐情感计算，这篇提醒你只靠声学特征不够，把「演唱技巧」显式建模才既提性能又能解释
articles.author: Fotini Kiriakopoulou, Vassilis Lyberatos 等
articles.body: Singing emotion recognition relies predominantly on deep learning models that achieve strong performance but offer limited insight into the vocal characteristics driving emotion, of- ten overlooking the singing voice as a distinct signal. We propose an interpretable singing emotion recognition framework using a compact set of singing-specific descriptors across prosody, spec- tral features, phonetics, and vocal technique. To decode model decisions and link predictions to measurable acoustic phenomena, we employ SHAP and apply GRAD-CAM to qualitatively assess the learned representations of vocal techniques. Evaluations show that singing-specific features reduce cross-singer variability, while vocal technique descriptors provide interpretable insights into singing expression. Furthermore, out-of-domain evaluation on VocalSet reveals interesting associations between emotional expression and ground-truth technical execution. The analysis highlights vibrato and pharyngeal techniques as salient cues of emotional delivery, with SHAP indicating that vibrato is context-dependent on articulation rate. These findings emphasize the value of domain-specific features for interpretable singing emotion analysis.
articles.bodyZh: 唱歌情感识别（singing emotion recognition）现在主要靠深度学习模型（deep learning models）：效果确实强，但模型很少告诉我们，到底是哪些声音特点在带动情感，而且常常没把歌声当成一种独立信号来看。我们提出了一套可解释的歌唱情感识别框架，只用一组精简的、专门针对歌唱的描述指标，覆盖韵律（prosody）、频谱特征（spectral features）、语音学特征（phonetics）和声乐技巧（vocal technique）。为了拆开模型决策、把预测结果和可测量的声学现象对应起来，我们用 SHAP 做解释，并用 GRAD-CAM 定性评估模型学到的声乐技巧表征。评估结果显示，歌唱专属特征能降低不同歌手之间的差异，而声乐技巧描述指标能让我们更好地理解歌唱表达。进一步，在 VocalSet 上做的域外评估（out-of-domain evaluation）还发现，情感表达和真实标注（ground-truth）的技巧执行之间有一些挺有意思的关联。分析指出，颤音（vibrato）和咽音技巧（pharyngeal techniques）是情感传达中很明显的线索；SHAP 还显示，颤音的作用跟咬字速度（articulation rate）有关，得看具体语境。这些发现说明，专用领域特征对可解释的歌唱情感分析很有价值。

articles.title: LGMT: A Tool for Testing the Logical Reasoning Reliability of LLMs
articles.zh: LGMT：一个测试LLM逻辑推理可靠性的工具
articles.summary: 如果你要拿LLM干需要严谨推理的活，先拿这类工具摸个底，别把「答得像」当成「推得对」
articles.author: Zenghui Zhou, Xiaoke Fang 等
articles.body: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as reasoning components in modern software systems, yet a model that answers a logical query correctly can contradict itself when the same problem is restated in an equivalent form. Static benchmarks evaluate queries in isolation and therefore fail to expose such inconsistencies. To address this limitation, we present LGMT, an open-source tool that detects reasoning inconsistencies through metamorphic relations grounded in first-order logic. Given a source test case in premise-conclusion form, LGMT generates logically equivalent follow-up cases and checks whether the model's entailment predictions agree across the pair, without ground-truth labels. The tool provides 20 built-in metamorphic relations, supports custom ones verified by the Z3 theorem prover, and runs from a CLI or a web studio, including an offline mock mode requiring no API key. Across six widely used LLMs on a bundled benchmark of 3,091 metamorphic groups, LGMT reveals inconsistency rates ranging from 20.84% to 29.44%. LGMT is publicly available on GitHub at https://github.com/MaxwelsDonc/lgmt-tool, with a demonstration video at https://youtu.be/gou4opptu1U.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）现在越来越多地被当作现代软件系统里的推理组件来用，但有个问题：一个模型可能把某道逻辑题答对了，可只要把同一个问题换个等价说法再问一遍，它就可能前后矛盾。静态基准测试（Static benchmarks）通常是孤立地测每一道题，所以根本发现不了这种不一致。为了解决这个盲区，我们做了 LGMT，一个开源工具，它靠基于一阶逻辑（first-order logic）的变形关系（metamorphic relations）来揪出推理不一致。你给它一个“前提-结论”形式（premise-conclusion form）的源测试用例，LGMT 就会生成逻辑上等价的后续用例，然后检查模型对这一对用例的蕴含预测（entailment predictions）是否一致，而且不需要标准答案标签（ground-truth labels）。这个工具内置了 20 种变形关系，也支持用户自定义，并用 Z3 定理证明器（Z3 theorem prover）来验证自定义关系；它既能在命令行界面（CLI）里跑，也能在网页工作台（web studio）里跑，还带一个不需要 API 密钥（API key）的离线模拟模式（offline mock mode）。在一个包含 3,091 个变形组（metamorphic groups）的打包基准测试集（benchmark）上，LGMT 测了六款常用大语言模型，发现它们的不一致率（inconsistency rates）在 20.84% 到 29.44% 之间。LGMT 已经在 GitHub 上公开：https://github.com/MaxwelsDonc/lgmt-tool，演示视频在这里：https://youtu.be/gou4opptu1U。

articles.title: What Transfers Across Protein Pockets? Experience Reuse in Molecular Optimization for Agentic Structure-Based Drug Design
articles.zh: 蛋白质口袋之间能迁移什么？Agent式基于结构药物设计中的分子优化经验复用
articles.summary: 如果你想让Agent在药物设计里「越做越熟练」，这篇说明经验跨口袋迁移是有边界的，别指望一套策略通吃
articles.author: Zaifei Yang, Weiyu Chen 等
articles.body: LLM agents optimize a ligand in a protein pocket by editing it step by step and docking each edit. Recent agents first spend extra dockings probing the complex with controlled edits; guidance induced from these probes is reported to help more than the chemical knowledge the model already carries. The probes are then discarded with the instance that produced them, so the obvious next step is to keep them in an experience base, letting a new pocket inherit what earlier ones already paid for. Such a base is read through a \emph{key}: the record properties under which past edits are pooled and a new one is looked up. Using the full log of one such run over the CrossDocked2020 test-set pockets, we ask whether its keys recur on a pocket the base has never seen and still separate improving from worsening edits. \crchange{Using} the contacts at the site being edited, the action, and the round as \crchange{a} key, the base separates them sharply. Within our analysis, this separation is largely explained by how much the edit changed the molecule's size, the action, and the round, none of which describes the target. That is not because the target is irrelevant: naming it outright separates them several times more sharply. For a pocket absent from the base, transfer must rely on a description rather than its identity. Among the exact-match descriptions we evaluate, the more specific ones rarely recur, whereas the coarser ones provide little separation; the signals that do transfer primarily describe the edit and the molecule it produced rather than the target. Under the representations and lookup scheme studied here, an experience base may be more useful for prioritizing an agent's own proposals for docking than for directly prescribing what to build.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型智能体（LLM agents）在优化蛋白质口袋（protein pocket）里的配体（ligand）时，是一步步编辑它，并对每一次编辑做对接（docking）。最近的一些智能体先花额外的对接次数，用受控编辑去探测这个复合物；据说从这些探针（probes）里得到的引导，比模型自带的化学知识还有用。但这些探针随后会和产生它们的那个实例一起被丢掉，所以下一步很自然：把它们存进经验库（experience base），让新口袋继承前面口袋已经付过成本的东西。这种经验库通过一个键（key）来读取：也就是按哪些记录属性把过去的编辑归到一起，并用来查新编辑。我们拿一次在 CrossDocked2020 测试集口袋上跑出来的完整日志，问：这些键会不会在一个经验库从没见过的口袋里再次出现，并且仍然能把变好的编辑和变坏的编辑分开？用编辑位点的接触特征（contacts）、动作（action）和轮次（round）当键，经验库能把它们分得很清楚。在我们的分析里，这种区分主要可以用编辑让分子大小变了多少、动作和轮次来解释，而这些都没有描述靶标（target）。这不是说靶标无关：直接把靶标点出来，区分度会高好几倍。对经验库里没有的口袋来说，迁移只能靠描述，不能靠它的身份。在我们评估的精确匹配描述里，越具体的描述越少重复出现，而越粗的描述又区分不出什么；真正能迁移的信号，主要描述的是编辑动作和它产出的分子，而不是靶标。在我们研究的表示（representations）和查询方案（lookup scheme）下，经验库可能更适合给智能体自己提出的对接方案排优先级，而不是直接规定该造什么。

articles.title: LLaCO: Continuous Diffusion for Large Language Models with Competition-Aware Semantic Scheduling
articles.zh: LLaCO：带竞争感知语义调度的LLM连续扩散方法
articles.summary: 如果你盯着扩散语言模型这条路线，这篇给连续扩散加了个语义调度器，重点看它怎么处理并行解码时的语义冲突
articles.author: Zijian Jia, Peixuan Zhang 等
articles.body: Continuous diffusion models have emerged as a promising non-autoregressive paradigm for text generation over continuous embedding spaces. Along the continuous trajectory, the residual token identity directly shapes the denoising objective. However, the geometric trajectory misaligns with temporal progression, triggering severe temporal compression. In this paper, we show that embedding norm decay causes Euclidean distance to yield spurious overtaking, indicating that token competition must be evaluated directionally. In this space, a candidate overtakes the source token only when the effective noise magnitude surpasses their semantic separation. We formalize these pairwise dynamics as the Competition Threshold Theory (CTT). Crucially, high-dimensional overtaking requires extreme noise levels, causing standard trajectories to concentrate identity decay into a narrow window near the noisy endpoint. To resolve this, we propose Semantic Retention Scheduling (SRS) to align time allocation with the progression of identity decay, and demonstrate that existing token identity metrics are fundamentally statistical aggregations of these pairwise crossings. Building on these theoretical insights, we introduce LLaCO, a generative framework powered by competition-aware semantic scheduling. LLaCO adapts a pretrained backbone to continuous representations via an embedding directional adapter and timestep-conditioned modulation. To operate within the directional space, LLaCO employs a spherical noising process formulated as a geodesic interpolation toward a mask-biased endpoint, eliminating norm decay while preserving accurate token competition. Guided by SRS, LLaCO reallocates the denoising trajectory proportionally to the logarithmic rank decay. Instantiated as an 8B model, LLaCO outperforms previous continuous diffusion baselines and rivals discrete diffusion models of comparable scale.
articles.bodyZh: 连续扩散模型（continuous diffusion models）已经成了文本生成里一个很有前景的非自回归范式（non-autoregressive paradigm），它是在连续嵌入空间（continuous embedding spaces）里做生成。沿着这条连续轨迹走，残差 token 身份（residual token identity）会直接影响去噪目标（denoising objective）。但问题是，几何轨迹（geometric trajectory）和时间推进（temporal progression）对不上，结果就出现了严重的时间压缩（temporal compression）。这篇论文里，我们说明：嵌入范数衰减（embedding norm decay）会让欧氏距离（Euclidean distance）算出一种“假超越”（spurious overtaking），也就是说，token 竞争（token competition）必须按方向来评估。在这个空间里，候选 token（candidate token）只有在有效噪声幅度（effective noise magnitude）超过它和源 token（source token）的语义间隔（semantic separation）时，才算真正超越源 token。我们把这些成对的动态关系总结成竞争阈值理论（Competition Threshold Theory, CTT）。关键是，高维超越（high-dimensional overtaking）需要极端高的噪声水平，所以标准轨迹会把身份衰减（identity decay）挤到靠近噪声端点（noisy endpoint）的一小段窗口里。为了解决这个问题，我们提出语义保留调度（Semantic Retention Scheduling, SRS），让时间分配跟身份衰减的进展对齐；同时证明，现有的 token 身份指标（token identity metrics）本质上就是这些成对交叉（pairwise crossings）的统计汇总。基于这些理论洞察，我们推出 LLaCO，这是一个由竞争感知语义调度（competition-aware semantic scheduling）驱动的生成框架（generative framework）。LLaCO 通过嵌入方向适配器（embedding directional adapter）和时间步条件调制（timestep-conditioned modulation），把预训练骨干模型（pretrained backbone）适配到连续表示（continuous representations）上。为了能在方向空间里运作，LLaCO 采用球面加噪过程（spherical noising process），把它写成朝着掩码偏置端点（mask-biased endpoint）做测地插值（geodesic interpolation），这样既消除了范数衰减，又能保住准确的 token 竞争。在 SRS 的指导下，LLaCO 按对数秩衰减（logarithmic rank decay）的比例重新分配去噪轨迹（denoising trajectory）。做成 8B 模型后，LLaCO 不仅超过了之前的连续扩散基线，也能跟同等规模的离散扩散模型（discrete diffusion models）掰手腕。

articles.title: PHYRD: A Living Benchmark for Reproducing and Extending Theoretical Physics Research
articles.zh: PHYRD：一个复现与拓展理论物理研究的「活」基准
articles.summary: 如果你在评估AI做科研的真实能力，这种要求复现并往前推一步真实理论物理工作的基准，比做物理题难得多也靠谱得多
articles.author: Qituan Zhang, Guo Chen 等
articles.body: Large language models and agents have shown significant power in advanced physical research. In this paper, We introduce PHYRD, a living benchmark for theoretical-physics reasoning with 63 Reproduce and 43 Discover problems. Reproduce tests derivation of published results; Discover tests consequences of modified theoretical conditions. FormulaForest constructs the tasks with reference solutions and subquestion-level rubrics. Across five models, whole-problem accuracy ranges from 49.21% to 68.25% on Reproduce and from 18.60% to 74.42% on closed-book Discover. With tools, four models complete more Discover problems, but conceptual errors and missing arguments persist. Besides, our experimental results demonstrate the value of FormulaForest as synthetic data. On FrontierScience, a benchmark developed by OpenAI, it raises the accuracy of a Qwen-35B-A3B model from 61% to 72%.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型和智能体（large language models and agents）在高级物理研究里已经展现出很强的能力。这篇论文里，我们推出了 PHYRD——一个“活”的基准测试（benchmark），专门用来评估理论物理推理（theoretical-physics reasoning），里面包含 63 道复现题（Reproduce）和 43 道发现题（Discover）。复现题考的是能不能推导出已发表结果；发现题考的是在修改过的理论条件下，能不能推出后续结论。公式森林（FormulaForest）负责构建这些任务，并配上参考解法和子问题级评分标准（subquestion-level rubrics）。在五个模型上，整题准确率在复现题上从 49.21% 到 68.25%，在闭卷发现题（closed-book Discover）上从 18.60% 到 74.42%。借助工具后，有四个模型能完成更多发现题，但概念性错误和论证缺失仍然存在。另外，我们的实验结果也证明了 FormulaForest 作为合成数据（synthetic data）的价值。在 OpenAI 开发的 FrontierScience 基准上，它把 Qwen-35B-A3B 模型的准确率从 61% 提到了 72%。

articles.title: Pseudo-Labels as Rewards, Not Targets: Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Semi-Supervised ASR
articles.zh: 伪标签当奖励而非目标：半监督ASR的组相对策略优化
articles.summary: 如果你在做半监督语音识别，把伪标签从「硬目标」改成「奖励信号」，可能正好绕开错标签把模型带偏这个老毛病
articles.author: Shashi Kumar, Yanis Labrak 等
articles.body: Adapting ASR to a domain with only untranscribed audio typically relies on pseudo-labeling, a strong teacher transcribes the audio and a student is fine-tuned on it. Because supervised fine-tuning (SFT) treats every pseudo-label token as a target, the student inherits the teacher's errors. We show that using the same pseudo-labels as a reward reference for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is more robust to label noise. In the banking domain, GRPO yields 29.3% to 56.2% relative WER improvements over SFT on Whisper-generated labels, and the advantage holds across four Whisper sizes, four teacher families, three domains and four languages. While SFT reproduces almost 100% of teacher errors verbatim, GRPO passes through only 27%. Rollout statistics explain why, erroneous pseudo-label words rarely appear in on-policy rollouts, so group-relative advantages stay aligned with the clean transcript, whereas SFT forces them into the policy's support and collapses the reward variance GRPO relies on.
articles.bodyZh: 把语音识别（ASR）适配到一个只有未转写音频的领域，通常靠伪标签（pseudo-labeling）：先让一个很强的教师模型把音频转写出来，再用这些结果去微调学生模型。问题是，监督微调（SFT）会把伪标签里的每个词都当成标准答案，教师模型犯的错，学生模型也照单全收。我们发现，把同一批伪标签拿来当组相对策略优化（GRPO）的奖励参照，对标签噪声更扛打。在银行领域，用 Whisper 生成的标签时，GRPO 相比 SFT 能把词错误率（WER）相对改善 29.3% 到 56.2%；而且这个优势在四种 Whisper 规模、四类教师模型、三个领域和四种语言上都成立。SFT 几乎会把教师模型的错误 100% 原样复制，GRPO 只放过去 27%。同策略采样（on-policy rollout）的统计结果能解释原因：错误的伪标签词很少出现在同策略采样里，所以组内相对优势始终和干净转写对齐；而 SFT 硬把这些错词塞进策略的支撑集（support），反而把 GRPO 依赖的奖励方差（reward variance）给压没了。

articles.title: Tool-Calling LLM Agents Under Realistic MCP Faults: Scale Does Not Purchase Fault Tolerance
articles.zh: 真实MCP故障下的工具调用LLM Agent：规模买不来容错能力
articles.summary: 如果你正把Agent接到一堆MCP工具上跑生产，这条结论得警惕——模型再大也不会自动扛住工具故障，容错得自己设计
articles.author: Antonio Ken Iannillo, Joshua Segun Owotogbe 等
articles.body: LLM agents increasingly rely on external tools exposed via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), yet current benchmarks assume tools respond correctly and on time, leaving agent resilience to realistic tool failures untested. We introduce MCP-Injector, a drop-in, protocol-aware fault-injection middleware that interposes on the MCP tool-call path with controlled persistence (permanent, transient, intermittent) and seedable schedules. Its fault model is calibrated to the observed incident distribution (failure mode x persistence) of the public MCP ecosystem, mined from 57,240 issue and pull-request threads across 1,774 open-source MCP repositories. In a 1,350-cell experiment crossing two backbone sizes (20B, 120B), three agent stacks (custom multi-round plan-and-execute, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain), and three fault injection conditions, we find that faults drawn from this permanent-heavy stress profile cause severe quality degradation (task-completion score falls by 60%, from 8.08 to 3.23 out of 10), and that scale does not purchase fault tolerance for the two gpt-oss backbones we test: the 120B retains no larger share of its fault-free score under faults (resilience-ratio model, $p = 0.96$), and its completion rate under faults is, if anything, lower (91.1% vs. 95.6%; difference 4.4 points, 95% CI $[-0.2, 9.3]$). Agent stacks differ in how well they absorb faults, which suggests that framework-level error handling matters more than model scale. These results demonstrate that capability benchmarks alone can mask operational brittleness, motivating protocol-aware fault injection as a complementary evaluation dimension for tool-calling agents.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型智能体（LLM agents）越来越依赖通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol，MCP）接进来的外部工具，但现在的基准测试（benchmarks）都默认工具会正确、按时响应，智能体碰上真实工具故障时扛不扛得住，其实没被测到。我们做了个 MCP-Injector，这是一个即插即用、协议感知（protocol-aware）的故障注入中间件（fault-injection middleware），插在 MCP 工具调用链路上，能按可控的故障持续性（persistence：永久、瞬时、间歇）和可设定随机种子的调度（seedable schedules）来注入故障。它的故障模型（fault model）是对着公开 MCP 生态里实际观察到的故障事件分布（故障模式（failure mode）×持续性）校准出来的，这些数据来自 1,774 个开源 MCP 仓库里的 57,240 条议题（issue）和拉取请求（pull request）讨论串。我们做了一个 1,350 个实验组合的测试，交叉了两种主干模型规模（20B、120B）、三种智能体技术栈（agent stacks：自研多轮“计划-执行”式、OpenAI Agents SDK、LangChain）和三种故障注入条件，结果发现：按这种以永久故障为主的压力配置注入故障后，质量掉得很厉害（任务完成分从 10 分制的 8.08 降到 3.23，掉了 60%）；而且规模并不能买来容错能力——我们测试的两个 gpt-oss 主干模型里，120B 在故障下保住的、相对无故障得分的比例并没有更大（韧性比例模型（resilience-ratio model），p = 0.96），它在故障下的完成率反而可能更低（91.1% 对 95.6%；差 4.4 个百分点，95% 置信区间（CI）[-0.2, 9.3]）。不同智能体技术栈吸收故障的能力不一样，这说明框架层面的错误处理比模型规模更关键。这些结果表明，光看能力基准测试会掩盖运行中的脆弱性，也说明该把协议感知的故障注入当成工具调用智能体的一个补充评测维度。

articles.title: Beyond Channel Data: Configuration-Enriched Radio Foundation Models
articles.zh: 超越信道数据：配置信息增强的无线电基础模型
articles.summary: 如果你在做无线通信基础模型，这篇提示只喂信道数据不够，把设备与网络配置一起编码才谈得上泛化
articles.author: Shrihari Vasudevan, H. G. Ranjani 等
articles.body: This paper proposes incorporating channel configuration (CFG) information into Radio Foundation Model (RFM) pre-training and demonstrates that the resulting CFG-enriched embeddings serve as effective inductive priors for downstream tasks under label scarcity. We compare the proposed embeddings with raw channel tokens and multiple baseline models, under three different data regimes, for multiple downstream tasks --- Line-of-Sight/Non-Line-of-Sight (LoS/NLoS) classification, timing advance (TA) estimation, and beam selection. Evaluation is done in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution configuration settings. Experimental outcomes show that the proposed embeddings consistently outperform and/or are competitive to the baselines, across experiments in both seen and unseen configuration scenarios.
articles.bodyZh: 本文提出把信道配置（CFG）信息纳入无线电基础模型（RFM）的预训练中，并证明由此得到的、富含CFG信息的嵌入（embeddings）能在标签稀缺（label scarcity）情况下，作为下游任务的有效归纳先验（inductive priors）。我们将所提出的嵌入与原始信道token以及多个基线模型进行比较，在三种不同的数据情形下，针对多个下游任务——视距/非视距（LoS/NLoS）分类、定时提前（TA）估计和波束选择（beam selection）——进行评估。评估在分布内（in-distribution）和分布外（out-of-distribution）的配置设置下进行。实验结果表明，在已见和未见配置场景的实验中，所提出的嵌入始终优于基线，和/或与基线相比具有竞争力。
